settings.headline: A museum of making in Rookwater
settings.subtitle: Helderwyn Museum of Making is a fictional craft, tools and industrial-design museum on the river in Rookwater.

settings.headline: What we collect
settings.body:
Hand tools, textiles, ceramics and the jigs living makers still use. The collection is arranged by gallery on the floor plan, and every object carries an accession number on its wall label.

The museum, the town of Rookwater, the people and the figures on this site are fictional. This is a Raytha example site.
settings.label: Every object has a wall label: title, maker, date, materials, credit line and accession number (HMM.year.sequence).

settings.headline: How the building works
settings.intro: Three public wings and a members Study Vault.

items.title: Ground floor
items.text: Entry Hall, Tool Hall, Textile Wing and Ceramic Court.

items.title: Upper Workshop Gallery
items.text: Temporary shows with living makers and their benches.

items.title: Study Vault
items.text: Members and researchers by appointment; not a public gallery.
